description: Returns the paid x402 request for your order of Agent discovery listing (POST /buy/listing, $290 in one payment; schema linked); this call places and charges nothing, and an order exists only if your own client pays that request. POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 or MPP client; the order id and status link come back with the receipt. Bad input is refused before any charge. Free check first: POST the same body plus your email to /buy/listing/check (email required there). Submits your live paid x402 endpoint URLs to open discovery indexes within 48 hours of payment (acceptance is up to each index), then reports visibility on day 7; for domain alerts use buy_brandwatch; for contacts use buy_lead_list.

email.description: optional: where to send the files too; without it they are on the order status page

items.description: https URL that answers HTTP 402 with x402 payment requirements
